title: Operations
subtitle: Check this server, run GPU, voice and visual checks, and keep sealed evidence safe.
loading: Loading what this server can run
loadError: Could not load the operations status
hostedNote: Hosted organizations run the doctor (suites, agents and runners) and the evidence jobs over their own runs. GPU and Kubernetes checks are run by the server owner.

health.title: Health
health.description: Preflight checks: docker, images, gateway, fault proxy, suites and agents.
health.hostedDescription: Checks your suites and agents, which runners are online, their last heartbeat and the shared runner pool.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Copy sealed experiments to the mirror, verify them, archive idle ones, back up the database, restore.
evidence.noMirror: No evidence mirror configured. Set storage.mirror_dir (a folder) or storage.s3 in the bench config, then restart the server.
evidence.restoreConfirm: Restore this experiment from the mirror into the runs folder?
evidence.backupConfirm: Back up the database and sweep every experiment to the mirror?
evidence.hostedDescription: Verify the seals of your experiments, download a zip backup of them, and archive or restore through the server's mirror.
evidence.hostedNoMirror: This server has no evidence mirror, so archive and restore are off. Verify and Back up still work: the backup is a zip you can download below.
evidence.hostedMirror: The server mirror keeps a copy of your sealed experiments; archive and restore use it.
evidence.hostedBackupConfirm: Write a zip of your sealed experiments (or the one named above) to your exports? You can download it below.
evidence.hostedRestoreConfirm: Restore this experiment of your organization from the server mirror?
evidence.backupsEmpty: No backups yet. Press Back up to make one.

suite.title: Suite checks
suite.description: Voice task images and visual references of a suite.
suite.image: Image path in the project, for example uploads/shot.png
suite.captureDescription: Screenshot a running browser or desktop container into uploads/visual/.

simulator.title: Simulator spread
simulator.description: How much a simulated-user model changes scores: the same experiment run with two simulator models.

workers.runnersBody: Runners take experiment slots from this server. Create a runner token in Settings, then run the start command it shows once on the runner machine.
